title: The longest bike ride — новые слова

items.example: It is the longest bicycle tour in the world.
In eighteen weeks you travel over 12,000 kilometres — it's the ride of your life.
A thousand years ago people travelled by camel and did twenty-five kilometres a day.
The tour crosses the Pamir Highway at over 4,600 metres.
The Silk Route passes a lake in northern China.
Cyclists cycle through a forest in Iran.
You travel across the deserts of China.
Cyclists shop in local markets for their food.
Along the way there are ancient buildings and famous monuments.
At night you stay in ancient roadside hotels.
The cyclists take turns cooking dinner every evening.
The best thing was the friendliness of the people.
A chef cooks dinner for about half of the 133 days.
On other days cyclists sleep in camps.
The Silk Route is a true expedition.
The tour cycles the Pamir Highway across the Roof of the World.
